name: ext-attack-path-agent-api
description: High-fidelity external attack-path sweep for Tenable Cloud Security via the public GraphQL API with a Bearer API token (no MCP connection). Same detection contract as the MCP edition: running, internet-direct workloads with an observed listening service, a remotely exploitable (AV:N, AC:Low) vulnerability with public evidence (EPSS >= 0.30 OR CISA KEV), component-to-port correlation, and identity-blast-radius tiering. Writes a two-tier HTML report; suitable for headless daily runs.
